page.layout: One printed page. Running head "NOTÆ." at top left, page number "233" at top right. One text column, mixed Latin, italic Latin and Arabic. No marginal notes. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: tes sibi à turpitudine cognominis, quod omnium consen-su cum infamia conjunctum est ob dictum Prophetæ. Atque ita nominis hujus notionem explicaturus Author libri AlMogreb, AlKadarii inquit, sunt, الغر قة[?] الـمجبرة الذين يثبتون كل الامر يقدر الله[?] وينسبون القبايح الى سبحانه[?] Secta AbJabario-rum, qui afferunt omnia ex decreto Dei pendere, & mala Deo benedicto attribuunt. Verùm ut observavit quidam cujus verba è margine in textum irrepsère licet in exemplari satis vetusto (scil. anno Hejræ 654. exarato) dudum est, ان جميع فرق الامة اتفقت الى صرف اسم القدرية الى المعتزلة[?] quod reliquæ omnes Mohammedanorum sectæ in hoc consenserint ut Alkadariorum nomen ad AlMotazalos tranferretur, quos Magorum (seu Majusiorum) similes in hoc præcipuè esse volunt, quod ut illi duos rerum authores statuebant, Lucem sive Deum, bonarum; Tenebras sive Diabolum, malarum; ita & Motazali, dum sc. ينسبون الخلق[?] والايجاد الى انفسهم في ادهم يقولون[?] الشرور والقبايح كلها لا الله[?] attribuunt creationem & rerum productionem, in eo quod dicunt, nos producimus mala & turpia omnia, non Deus, cùm (inquit) اهل السنة[?] ii qui traditionem & viam consuetam sectantur يتسبون القبايح بقضا الله[?] وقدره ولكن لا يقولون ان القبايح برضاة بل يقولون بارادته وقدره والتفاوت ثابت بين الرضا والارادة لغة وعرفا كما في شرب المريض الدوا اذه[?]

page.notes: Right margin is empty; no marginal notes. Arabic passages are transcribed as best read from the scan; the exact letters of the Arabic lines (notably "الغر قة", "الـمجبرة", "ينسبون", "والايجاد", and the final words of the last line) are uncertain and marked [?]. The catchword "مريدين" at the foot right is uncertain. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin follow the scan as far as legible. Possible printing variants "afferunt" / "asserunt" and "tranferretur" are left as printed. The first word "tes" is a fragment and kept as such.
